text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—Wahahahahaha!!
Ojō, you are so crazyyyyyy—!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That's seriously so insane, right?!
My lady! Let's shake things up even moreーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(What erratic, unbridled strength...!
――...In that case, I just have to surpass it...!)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That's it!! That sparkling look!!
Let's turn up the heat! Fuuuuuuuuuuuu!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—Awwwww yeeeah!!
Level UP~~!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Helios~~~~!
You were blasting through the track today too~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Right!? Like, listen to this!?
It was so freaking fun!?!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Running with Ojo is,
like, a billion times more hype than I thought it'd beee!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't this crazy hyped, and so tight!?
Like, for real, I neeeeed you to fall for me!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaah...!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Daiichi Ruby narrowly missed achieving a three-generation victory—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(I couldn't live up to their expectations.
I failed to achieve a 3-generation sweep just now... Above all else.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Helios-san's speed, her sheer strength.
There's no way I can overlook that.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: For the one who will go beyond that is...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Incredible.
Both Helios and Ruby...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"What I'm aiming for is...
What a dizzying world it is."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
To repay everyone—to win a GⅠ...
I have to face those two.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That fleeting glimpse of Ruby's blinding speed...
...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...I have to work harder... even harder.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Faster, I have to get even, even faster!

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan A
text_block_list.text:
...Daiichi Ruby was so close!
I bet the "Illustrious Family" isn't satisfied with that, though.

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Well, but I really feel like I witnessed a piece of history.
...Now then, next up is the long-awaited Osaka Hai!

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan B
text_block_list.text: I can't wait to see who wins—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After the race concluded, she seemed deep in thought about something, entirely apart from her feelings about the defeat.
choice_data_list: Did something happen during the race?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
It appears what you told me before
was correct.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: “—Daitaku Helios-san... Her strength is the real deal...”

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"I felt that if I didn't hone my speed even further,
I would fall even further behind."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Going forward, she will likely become a wall I'll run into many times.
choice_data_list: Which means... you're my rival, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
If calling it that
makes it easier to understand.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Milady... Did you just call me...
your rival...?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes, that is what I said.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
There is something truly remarkable
about your running.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...Nghhh!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: We need to discuss our next race, so we will take our leave now.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
!!
Wait!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Milady, where are you going?
I'm coming too!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...I was thinking we should continue targeting GⅠ races.
What are your thoughts, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Today's performance proved that Daiichi Ruby can achieve fantastic results at short distances too. Considering her goals, I want to keep her level high.
choice_data_list: In that case, maybe the Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "The Yasuda Kinen is also a G1, a major race that crowns the mile champion of the first half of the year."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Got it, the Yasuda Kinen, right?
Roger that!
choice_data_list: Are you sure we can decide that so easily?!
Are you sure we can decide that so easily?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Tbh, it's all about the vibe!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I'm her rival, after all!
I'll hype the young lady up again!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Btw, this is way too fun~~~!
I'm definitely not letting you get away now!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Thx☆
Sending big luv♪

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...Who else is under consideration
for the 'Yasuda Kinen'?"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: What is it?
choice_data_list: I just thought it was rare for you to show interest...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
The runners are the most critical factor in deciding victory or defeat...
as we have always made sure to check.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, the way she asked that almost sounded like she was hoping for a battle against a totally different "rival"... Or was it just my imagination?
choice_data_list: Bamboo Memory has also declared her entry

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory... the mile champion of the
previous generation. Without a doubt,
she counts as one of the fiercest rivals.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I was merely reviewing my assigned tasks. There is no psychological change.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Now then, please proceed with the entry registration.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the next target race was decided: the Yasuda Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: (...To burn, huh.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: (A fiery excitement... is rising in me――?)
